title: Vikunja from 2.2.1 before 2.8.0 contains a TOTP replay protection bypass in ValidateTOTPPasscode that allows attackers…
description: Vikunja versions from 2.2.1 up to but not including 2.8.0 have a vulnerability in the TOTP validation process. The flaw allows attackers with valid credentials to bypass replay protection by padding previously used TOTP codes with whitespace and resubmitting them within the code's validity window to gain a session token.
